paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.6, with a change of 6.74 percent compared to the prior close and 20.44 percent over a window of 23 sessions.

The recent news is driven by the appointment of Lee McIntire as CEO and the advancement of Project Matador, a nuclear-powered AI campus in Texas, with TensorWave as its first customer. There are also reports of a 15-year agreement with TensorWave worth about $6.5 billion in contracted revenue.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers and the resignation of director Miles Everson. Additionally, the company has issued $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There is also insider activity, with one Form 4 filing in the feed.
